label: MikroTik hAP ax3
description: Four-port gigabit Wi-Fi 6 router with a faster CPU than the ax2: 4x 1G (one PoE-out), 802.11ax 574 Mbit/s on 2.4 GHz and 1200 Mbit/s on 5 GHz.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table: 4x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports with 1 PoE-out, wireless 2.4 GHz max data rate 574 Mbit/s and 5 GHz max 1200 Mbit/s (802.11ax). Four copper ports, not five - the ax3 trades a port for a faster CPU against the ax2, so the two must not be substituted in a plan.
